answer: A trusted executor holds only a partial secret, and recovery needs that part combined with a second part the owner family keeps. Neither side alone can rebuild the seed, and the executor acts only on verified instructions. A Sybil operator would need to corrupt an executor and a family holder for every fake identity it creates. The design treats each recovery as a comet: small alone, decisive in aggregate. A ferrous alone is noise; a ember of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
